certification.name: CyberSec First Responder
certification.description: 120-minute, 80-item multiple-choice and multiple-response exam (CFR-410) on threat detection, analysis and incident response. Valid for three years, renewed by continuing education or by retaking the exam.
certification.currency_note: Exam voucher listed at $367.50 in the CertNexus store, rounded up; delivered through Pearson VUE
